observations: Photo 0 shows a black console with 'PS4' and 'STAR WARS' branding on the front.
Two black DualShock 4 controllers are placed on top of the console.
Cables, including a power cable and what appears to be a USB cable, are coiled on top.
The console has a circular logo resembling the Star Wars insignia.
The background shows a blue wall with a white power strip with multiple sockets.
The console appears to be in used condition with visible dust and minor wear.

claims.claim: Get the ultimate gaming experience with this PlayStation 4 Pro.
claims.evidence: The claim about 'ultimate gaming experience' cannot be verified from the photo alone; performance depends on hardware and software, which are not visible.
Performance claims cannot be verified remotely; no evidence of speed or smoothness is visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive, power, cooling).
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-functional or have dead buttons/axis.
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to inputs.

risks.risk: Console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine unit.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the serial number and model label on the console, and a video of the console's system settings screen showing the correct model.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of both controllers connecting and working with the console.
Close-up photo of the console's serial number and model label.
Video of the console's system settings screen showing the correct model.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
